independentReview.result: Accept as shaped for this bounded family; no actionable P0-P3 findings, production dependencies or required maintainer decisions.

nativeApplicationEvidence.workflow: Open without repair; retain three replacements/tabs/spacing and untouched rich paragraph; further native edit; save/close/reopen; native DOCX and best-quality one-page PDF export.
nativeApplicationEvidence.independentPreservation: 13 entries/93 IWA messages; only three requested UTF-8 ranges change, with native properties and all other bytes unchanged. Native DOCX/strict DOCX retain authored text, spacing and tabs.

qualificationLimits: Fixed-length plain uniform Pages body paragraphs with no selected list/hyperlink and no body attachments, nonempty headers/footers or multiple sections. Both UTF-16 and UTF-8 lengths must match.
Pending edits compose, failed/cancelled operations preserve pending state, and restoring original text restores original bytes.
Native visual caches and previews remain unrefreshed and require explicit acceptance. Wider application metadata is unassessed.
Native and complete composed PDFs retain ordered authored content. Portable font substitution and monochrome emoji differ; native typography/pagination equivalence is unqualified.
Actual NET8/NET10 NativeAOT execution on macOS arm64 only. PDF AOT, other architectures, physical devices and broader edit families remain separate.
Source only; no push, PR, public merge, package release or deployment.

renderingBaselineComparison.pdfDeclaredStyle: Helvetica-Bold14 points for Rich in baseline and candidate; following plain text Helvetica12; saved strict DOCX retains bold14/plain12.
